evidence.note: Bury points to diction, chronology around Echecrates and the generic character of the letter as evidence for a later hand.
The review of Morrow includes Letter IX among the rejected or suspect letters.
Helfer's 2023 unified-reading thesis preserves a serious recent defense of the collection as a Platonic work.

rationale: Letter IX is repeatedly identified as one of the weakest claims within the canonical thirteen. Bury points to diction, chronology and the commonplace character of the text, and Morrow rejected or suspected it. Ancient citation by Cicero and recent literary-unity arguments prevent treating the matter as equivalent to extra-canonical spuria, but the modern balance remains strongly against Plato; C is appropriate.
